name: command-palette
title: Command Palette
description: Searchable command dialog with ranking, optional async source, and recent ids.

api.description: Searchable command dialog over kit Dialog. Ranks static commands, optional async results, and recent ids, then runs the active command.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Uncontrolled initial open state.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when open changes. Closing clears the query and async session.

props.name: commands
props.description: Static command list (required).

props.name: source
props.description: Optional async source. Debounced while open; merged with static commands.

props.name: recentIds
props.description: Command ids promoted when the query is empty.

props.name: onRun
props.description: Called after a command is chosen, before command.run().

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Search field placeholder. Defaults to the string catalogue.

props.name: background
props.description: Search field fill, forwarded to SearchInput.

props.name: emptyContent
props.description: Empty status content when nothing matches. Defaults to the string catalogue.

props.name: footer
props.description: Footer content under the list. Defaults to short keyboard hints.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional styles on DialogContent.

props.name: id
props.description: Stable id (required).

props.name: label
props.description: Visible and searchable label (required).

props.name: section
props.description: Group heading. Falls back to the catalogue commands label.

props.name: keywords
props.description: Extra strings included in ranking.

props.name: rankTier
props.description: Ranking band for query results. Lower tiers sort before higher tiers.

props.name: glyph
props.description: Leading mark on the option row.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Optional shortcut shown with Kbd.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Non-runnable option.

props.name: run
props.description: Action invoked when the command runs (required).

groups.title: Keyboard and accessibility
groups.description: Dialog (aria-label): DialogContent receives the catalogue command-palette accessible name. Search (combobox): Search input is a combobox with aria-controls and aria-activedescendant pointing at the active option. List (listbox): Results render as a listbox of options. Arrow keys move the active option; Enter runs it; Escape closes.
